description: This file implements the RemoveSource class, which is responsible for removing a media source (specifically audio) in a GStreamer-based media playback system. It handles clearing buffers, updating context flags, and sending flush events to the GStreamer source element.

classes.name: RemoveSource
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the logic to remove a media source, specifically handling the cleanup and GStreamer flush events for the specified media type.

methods.name: RemoveSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RemoveSource object with the given context, client, GStreamer wrapper, and media source type.

methods.name: ~RemoveSource
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the RemoveSource object lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the removal of the media source by clearing buffers, updating context flags, and sending flush events to the GStreamer source element.
